title: I'm a Behemoth, an S-Ranked Monster, but Mistaken for a Cat, I Live as an Elf Girl's Pet
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A knight killed by demons is reborn as a baby behemoth that looks like a kitten. The elf adventurer Aria adopts him as her pet Tama, unaware of what he is, and he secretly protects her with monstrous powers as she grows into a warrior, while several other women in their party also fall for him and they fight demons seeking to revive a God of Darkness.
life_message: Loyalty and protecting the one you love give purpose to a second life.
